about_the_game:
The race of the millennium is about to begin. 

Millennium Runners is the ultimate anti-gravity racing experience: speed beyond all limits, adrenaline-fueled circuits and four racing teams ready for anything to win the Millennium Cup. In this remote future, where speed is synonymous with power and the racetrack is the battleground, only the best will join the legend. 

Take on adrenaline-pumping challenges at incredible speed, dominate the corners with breathtaking manoeuvres and make your mark on galacting racing history. 

KEY FEATURES 

  • Limitless Speed - Experience the thrill of top speed with a smooth and responsive driving system that defines the best arcade racing experiences. 

  • Iconic Circuits - Race on breathtaking tracks on remote planets, through vertical cities and futuristic environments — crafted for fans of futuristic racing games. 

  • Legendary racing team - Choose from different unique teams, each with their own advanced technology and racing philosophy. 

  • Iconic soundtrack - Every drift, overtake, and explosion comes alive with an energetic electronic soundtrack, amplifying your racing experience.

THREE GAMES MODES

  • Race: challenge NPCs opponents, use boosts and power-ups and cross the finish line before anyone else!

  • Time Attack: run extraordinary race times to earn medals and break your records in classic time trial mode. 

  • Last Ship Standing: every 90 seconds the last one is eliminated. Be the last standing in the race!

The future of racing is here.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-13700H
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Xe Graphics G7 96
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-14650HX
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia RTX 4060
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 15 GB available space

short_description: The ultimate anti-gravity racing experience. Millennium Runners is an homage to classic arcade racing games. Speed through futuristic cities and planets in adrenaline-fueled competitions. Choose your team, conquer the Millennium Cup, and race your way into legend!
